description: Pub. 596 (2025) Worksheet 1 line 6: 'Enter any gain from Form 4797, line 7' — subtracted from capital gain net income. Head of household, one child, wages $20,000 and a $15,000 § 1231 gain on business land: investment income is $0, and the EITC equals that of the same return with $15,000 of non-investment income ($2,462) — the same gain as a capital gain would exceed the $11,950 limit.
